name: ovos-stt-plugin-rover
description: This plugin is a meta-STT engine for OVOS. It runs several STT backends in parallel and combines their output with the ROVER (Recognizer Output Voting Error Reduction) algorithm. The result is a single, more accurate transcript, at the cost of running more than one STT engine per utterance.
author: TigreGotico

setup_notes.heading: Installation
setup_notes.content:
pip install ovos-stt-plugin-rover

Install the backend STT plugins you want to aggregate as well.
